title: Naveen Gadde

tagline: Notes on leadership, reliability and the questions that move us forward.
description: Essays, frameworks, books and the "A Thought Experiment" series by Naveen Gadde, collected from LinkedIn in one place.
subscribe_line: One email when a new volume or framework is published. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.
short_bio: Part engineer, part poet. Learning across India, Scotland and the United States taught me that the same problem looks different depending on where you stand, so I became a collector of perspectives. I turn them into thought experiments, frameworks and short books, and share them so others can build on them.
motto: Think Big. Act Wise. Bring Clarity.
